method: scripts/qa/sweep-eye-clearance-spots.ts (legality) then sweep-eye-clearance-live.mjs (analytic eye seats vs canonical shot surfaces) then scripts/qa/verify-eye-clearance-runtime.mjs (teleports the REAL player to every flagged spot, matching stance, and re-probes from the actual camera seat - i.e. after src/camera-eye-clearance.ts resolveEyeClearance runs)
roster: All three stages derive the arena roster from SELECTABLE_ARENAS in src/map-selection.ts - stage 1 imports it, stages 2 and 3 scrape it through scripts/qa/eye-clearance-roster.mjs (floor of 7, so a scrape that stops matching throws instead of yielding an empty roster). `ceilings` must therefore carry exactly one entry per selectable arena, no more and no fewer: scripts/qa/eye-clearance-sweep-contract.test.mjs FAILS when the roster and this ledger disagree, which is what let the five-id ceiling set outlive a seven-arena game unnoticed.

unmeasured.note: Never measured by stage 2. The live sweep hardcoded a five-arena roster, so test1 was never opened, never probed, and never asked the ledger for a ceiling - the missing-ceiling guard could not fire for an arena that never reached the loop. Entered at the -1 UNMEASURED sentinel, which is below the smallest possible measurement, so the ratchet is RED for test1 until someone runs the sweep with a browser and writes down the number it actually finds. A guessed ceiling here would pre-forgive whatever test1 turns out to do.

Same as test1. accepted.rows: wallbang-panel glass (0.052 m) and brick (0.000 m), crouch
accepted.reason: The panels are authored solid:false, shots:true - deliberately walk-through range fixtures you shoot targets through. A player standing inside one clips by design; making them movement-solid would change what the range IS. Accepted, not deferred.

Escalator flank fringe: eye 11 mm inside the near-plane+bob margin beside the sloped belly. Real but sub-centimetre-class; fixing means reshaping the rotated stair collider. Deferred with numbers, revisit on any player report.

accepted.reason: Ramp edge fringe: 0.096 m clears the bare 0.08 m near plane and only enters the margin with full bob amplitude. Deferred with numbers.

A geometry fix means clearance pads on ramp flanks, which is navigation-coupled (ramp-foot anchors and traversal gates live exactly there) - deferred with numbers, revisit on any player report.

runtimeResolve.module: src/camera-eye-clearance.ts (resolveEyeClearance), wired at the end of the local camera seat in legacy-main
runtimeResolve.behaviour: per-frame probes push the eye so no solid-backed shot surface lies within 0.15 m; shallow volume intrusions depenetrate through the nearest face (limit 0.4 m, push cap 0.34 m); wallbang panels and breakable window panes are design-exempt

runtimeResolve.note: Every remaining runtime row clears the bare 0.08 near plane by >=1.5x and enters the conservative 0.15 margin only at full bob. The felt "clipping near walls / prone" classes (ramp flanks, airstair belly) resolve to >= 0.136.
